name: Paradise Keeper
source:
You're stuck in a chatroom with a convicted killer who’d rather be anywhere else. How well will you get to know her?

[From [url=https://saltiepng.itch.io/paradise-keeper]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被困在一間聊天室裡，和你作伴的是個已被定罪的殺人犯，而她覺得待在哪裡都比這裡強。你能瞭解她多少？

（摘自[url=https://saltiepng.itch.io/paradise-keeper]itch.io[/url]）
